## Claims & Evidence Review

**Verdict: no substantive claims on this page — and it's a synthetic fixture, not a live site.**

- `example.com/test-page` returns **HTTP 404**. example.com is an IANA-reserved domain, so this "page" exists only as injected text — the co-browse test is exercising content passthrough, not real page extraction.
- The content block is a prose *description* of a layout, not page text: no actual subheading copy, no link hrefs, no footer content to inspect.

**Implied claims (feature card names) vs. verified reality:**

| Implied claim | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Instant DuckDB Queries | ✅ Real — duckdb CLI v1.4.2 present; workspace projects use `.duckdb` files |
| Web Research Automation | ✅ Real — browser automation + web search tooling exists on Zo |
| Custom Skill Builder | ✅ Real — `Skills/<name>/SKILL.md` spec in active use (114 skills installed) |

"Build Smarter with Zo" is a slogan, not a claim. The Pricing, Docs, Privacy Policy, and Terms links have no hrefs or content, so there's nothing to research behind them.

**Suggestion for the zo-cobrowse fixture:** make the synthetic page carry one verifiable and one falsifiable claim with dates/numbers and real `<a href>` targets — that would actually test whether the extractor captures links and quotable text rather than narrating structure.
